name: Ca doi muoi hot
summary: Cá đối nổ muối hột is mullet buried in coarse salt and cooked by the heat of the salt, which pops in the pan. People in Cần Giờ also call the fish cá đối buôi. Dân Việt says this is the famous cook, rather than grilling. The flesh stays moist and smells of coarse salt and lemongrass. Eat it in rice paper with forest leaves.
howToEat: The fish is cooked in the salt, not over a grill. Take the flesh, roll it in rice paper with forest leaves.
